title: plots
description: Every plot and table the project's drawings made (Implementation Decision 17; ticket 100): research/plots.json, written only by wayline.drawings through the ledger. A plot keeps its id across drawings (R4.3, tables R4.T1), redrawn while useful, retired when a drawing leaves it out or the owner dropped it, and never reused. The owner's mark and note come from the plots batches of wayline.batches.

chart_type.description: the canonical chart type it draws; null for a table

index_entries.description: the plot index entries it follows

headline.description: one of the at most four headline plots its latest drawing marked

note.description: the owner's note, an instruction for the plot's next drawing

drawings.description: the drawings that drew it, in order
